core_meaning.primary_meaning: Nasirah is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Helper, supporter”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Nasirah corresponds to the Arabic form نَاصِرَة (Arabic root ن ص ر (n-ṣ-r); نَاصِرَة (Nāṣira)). Its core sense is nacira; helper, supporter (feminine). Nasirah is Arabic نَاصِرَة (Nāṣira) 'helper, supporter' (feminine), from the root ن ص ر (n-ṣ-r). The source gloss 'Helper, Supporter' is consistent. Same name as nacira.

persian.name: ناصره
